description: A subnet the router's DHCP server leases IPv4 addresses of on its interfaces: pools and reservations, the options its clients get and the files PXE clients boot.

bios.description: File of clients with BIOS firmware, of architecture 0 in option 93, loaded over TFTP from server.

ipxe.description: Script or file of clients that run iPXE already, whose user class (option 77) is iPXE; they get it instead of bios and uefi, so that iPXE does not load itself again.

server.description: IPv4 address of the TFTP server the files are on, the DHCP header's next server; needed with bios or uefi, whose firmware loads them over TFTP. null for none, as for an ipxe script of an HTTP URL alone.

uefi.description: File of clients with x86-64 UEFI firmware, of architecture 7 or 9 in option 93, loaded over TFTP from server.

boot.description: Files PXE clients boot, by firmware; boot files are served elsewhere. null serves none.

x-chalkos-rules.message: boot names no file; give bios, uefi or ipxe, or leave boot out
x-chalkos-rules.rule: self == null || self.bios != null || self.uefi != null || self.ipxe != null

x-chalkos-rules.description: A boot's server is an IPv4 address.
x-chalkos-rules.message: boot's server is no IPv4 address

x-chalkos-rules.description: A boot of BIOS or UEFI files names their server.
x-chalkos-rules.message: boot's bios and uefi files load over TFTP from boot's server; give server
x-chalkos-rules.rule: self == null || self.server != null || (self.bios == null && self.uefi == null)

dns.description: DNS servers the clients ask, IPv4 addresses.

x-chalkos-rules.description: The DNS servers are IPv4 addresses.
x-chalkos-rules.messageExpression: "the DNS server " + self.filter(a, ip(a).family() != "ipv4")[0] + " is no IPv4 address"

domain.description: Domain of the clients' names, which they also search; null gives none.

gateway.description: Router the clients route through, inside the subnet and neither its network nor its broadcast address; null gives them none.

interfaces.description: Links the server answers on, each by its full name, without a glob: links of one VRF, each of which a Network document matching it by Name= alone gives a static address in the subnet. A link takes one subnet.

leaseTime.description: How long a lease lasts: a number and s, m, h or d, 136 years at most.

pools.description: Ranges the server leases addresses from to any client, inside the subnet, apart from each other, from the reservations and from the router's, the gateway's and the DNS and boot servers' addresses; empty leases the reservations alone.

last.description: Last address of the pool, no lower than the first.

reservations.description: Clients that always get the same address, by their MAC address.

address.description: Address the client always gets, inside the subnet and outside its pools, neither the router's nor the gateway's nor a DNS or boot server's.

hostname.description: Name the client gets; null gives none.

mac.description: MAC address of the client, in lower case.

x-chalkos-rules.description: A MAC address has one reservation.
x-chalkos-rules.messageExpression: "the MAC address " + self.filter(r, size(self.filter(x, x.mac == r.mac)) > 1)[0].mac + " has more than one reservation"
"the address " + self.filter(r, size(self.filter(x, ip(x.address) == ip(r.address))) > 1)[0].address + " is reserved more than once"

subnet.description: IPv4 range the subnet's addresses are in, of 30 bits at most.

x-chalkos-rules.description: A subnet is an IPv4 range of 30 bits at most, outside 0.0.0.0/8, 127.0.0.0/8, 169.254.0.0/16 and 224.0.0.0/3.
x-chalkos-rules.messageExpression: "the subnet " + self + " is no IPv4 range of 30 bits at most of addresses a DHCP server leases"

title: DHCPSubnet

rules.description: A DHCPSubnet's pools lie inside its subnet.
rules.messageExpression: documents.filter(n, cel.bind(s, documents[n].spec, cel.bind(c, cidr(s.subnet), !(s.pools.all(p, c.contains(ip(p.first)) && c.contains(ip(p.last))))))).map(n, "DHCPSubnet " + n).join(", ") + " has a pool outside its subnet"
rules.rule: documents.all(n, cel.bind(s, documents[n].spec, cel.bind(c, cidr(s.subnet), s.pools.all(p, c.contains(ip(p.first)) && c.contains(ip(p.last))))))

rules.description: A DHCPSubnet's reservations lie inside its subnet.
rules.messageExpression: documents.filter(n, cel.bind(s, documents[n].spec, cel.bind(c, cidr(s.subnet), !(s.reservations.all(r, c.contains(ip(r.address))))))).map(n, "DHCPSubnet " + n).join(", ") + " has a reservation outside its subnet"
rules.rule: documents.all(n, cel.bind(s, documents[n].spec, cel.bind(c, cidr(s.subnet), s.reservations.all(r, c.contains(ip(r.address))))))

rules.description: A DHCPSubnet's gateway lies inside its subnet.
rules.messageExpression: documents.filter(n, cel.bind(s, documents[n].spec, cel.bind(c, cidr(s.subnet), !(s.gateway == null || c.contains(ip(s.gateway)))))).map(n, "DHCPSubnet " + n).join(", ") + " has a gateway outside its subnet"
rules.rule: documents.all(n, cel.bind(s, documents[n].spec, cel.bind(c, cidr(s.subnet), s.gateway == null || c.contains(ip(s.gateway)))))
